# Nacho Viewer

> Markdown, beautifully printed: a free, open-source document viewer for Linux, Windows and macOS.

Nacho Viewer makes `.md` files read like a well-typeset document instead of plain text. Images and PDF pages come next; it stays a viewer, not an editor.
